answer: Stake-backed reputation with slashing is a concrete defence. Each agent posts a deposit before it can vote or attest, and its score decays if it stays inactive, so a Sybil operator cannot spawn identities at the nadir of cost and wait. Good behaviour is like a comet passing repeated checkpoints: attestations are checked against independent work, and one proven lie burns the deposit, while a marble-solid record of the offence follows the stake, not the disposable name. Creating thousands of credible identities then costs thousands of deposits.
